description: The ASCII Ripples live wallpaper behind empty VS Code editors.
config.enabled: Show ASCII Ripples behind empty editor groups. Turning it off restores the original VS Code files.
config.theme.time: Follows the sun, like the desktop wallpaper (night, dusk, golden hour, day).
config.theme.vscode: Takes the colors of the current VS Code color theme.
config.theme.auto: Dark or light, following macOS appearance.
config.longitude: Longitude for the time-of-day theme (empty = from the time zone).
config.opacity: Opacity of the wallpaper layer (1 = as on the desktop).
config.fps: Frame rate limit; lower saves battery (0 = display rate).
config.chars: Characters the field is made of.
config.waves: Clicking an empty editor sends out a wave.
config.flashlight: Glyphs light up under the mouse pointer.
config.heartChance: Chance (%) that a wave is heart-shaped.
config.showWatermark: Keep the VS Code logo over the wallpaper (the shortcut hints always stay).
config.colors: Custom colors for the `dark` and `light` themes, e.g. `{ "dark": { "bg": "#141416", "text": "#96969e", "wave": "#4696eb" } }`.
config.advanced: Any other wallpaper setting by its internal name, e.g. `{ "blobSize": 400, "waveLife": 8 }`. See the extension README for the list.
config.trackpad.touch: A finger landing on the trackpad sends a wave where the pointer is, without pressing (macOS).
config.trackpad.clickArea: Where on the trackpad a click has to land to send a wave, like the desktop app's setting. A mouse click counts everywhere but Never.
config.trackpad.clickArea.anyEdge: Any edge of the trackpad (the outer fifth).
config.trackpad.secondaryClick: A two-finger (secondary) click also sends a wave.
config.trackpad.port: Local port the trackpad relay uses between VS Code windows.
